scope: Theorem 4.1 (Wave-envelope estimate and extensions) of the manuscript “Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation” (preprints/Critical-local-smoothing-for-the-three-dimensional-wave-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 079 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79299093c07ea305), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L ≥ 2, and let the Fourier transform of F be supported in an O(L−1)-neighborhood of a fixed compact annular patch of the cone in R3. Use a smooth, boundedly overlapping decomposition into angular sectors ϑ of width L−1/2. For each dyadic L−1/2 ≲ R ≲ 1, let τ range over a boundedly overlapping cover by angular caps of width R. Let Uτ,L be the associated envelope box, with dimensions L, LR, and LR2 in the adapted ray frame, and tile space by its translates. Then, for every ε > 0, ∥F∥4 L4 ≲ε Lε X L−1/2≲R≲1 X τ: |τ|∼R X U∥Uτ,L |U|−1   Z U X ϑ⊂O(τ) ∥Fϑ∥2   2 . (GWZ) The assertion holds for functions taking values in a separable Hilbert space, with a constant independent of that space. Fixed thickness constants, bounded enlargements of tiles, and adapted rapidly decreasing tile weights are allowed.
